# Sgn

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Sgn(value)
```

## Description

The sign of a number: -1 for a number below 0, 0 for 0 and 1 for a number above 0, as an integer or a float like the number.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Sgn(-12)
Print Sgn(0)
Print Sgn(0.5)
```

```text
-1
0
1.0
```
